name: Rankd Free Shipping Progress Bar
author: Rankd.site

sections.description:
Customers add more to their cart when they can see how close they are to free shipping. This plugin shows a message and progress bar with the amount left to go, then switches to a confirmation once they qualify. It updates as items are added or removed, with no page reload.

Features

  • Show it automatically on the cart page, the checkout page, or both
  • Or place it anywhere with the shortcode [rankd_free_shipping]
  • Set your own threshold amount and message text
  • Add an optional coupon code to the success message, for stores where free shipping needs one
  • Hide the message from chosen user roles, such as wholesale customers
  • Match your store: colors, font, text size and rounded corners, with a live preview
  • Built-in contrast check, so your color choices stay readable
  • Works with classic and block-based cart and checkout pages

Getting started

Settings are under WooCommerce → Settings → Free Shipping Progress. Nothing appears on your store until you turn on Auto-inject or add the shortcode.

For Developers

Filters:

  • rankd_fs_threshold: change the threshold amount
  • rankd_fs_subtotal: change the cart amount it is compared against
  • rankd_fs_msg_notice, rankd_fs_msg_success, rankd_fs_msg_coupon_line: change the message text

Example:

add_filter( 'rankd_fs_threshold', function( $threshold ) {
    return is_user_logged_in() ? 75 : 50;
});

The CSS classes for custom styling are listed on the Appearance tab under CSS Class Reference.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Free Shipping Progress.
  3. Set your threshold amount and messages.
  4. Turn on Auto-inject for the cart or checkout page, or add [rankd_free_shipping] where you want the message.
sections.faq:
I activated the plugin but nothing is showing. Why?

The message only appears once you choose where it goes. In the settings, turn on one of the Auto-inject options or add the shortcode [rankd_free_shipping] to a page.

Does it update without reloading the page?

Yes. The message refreshes within a few seconds of the cart changing.

Can I change the colors and font?

Yes. Open the Appearance tab in the plugin settings. A live preview shows your changes before you save.

Can I show the text without the progress bar?

Yes. Add .rankd-fs-bar-track { display: none; } to Appearance → Customize → Additional CSS.

My shipping zones have different minimums. Will this work?

The plugin shows one threshold to all visitors. If your zones share the same minimum, it works as expected. If they differ, the message will not match every customer.

Does it work with page builders?

Yes, including Elementor, Divi and Beaver Builder. Fonts from your theme or page builder appear in the font list.

Does it work with caching plugins?

Yes. The message loads fresh after the page does, so cached pages still show the right amount.

Does the threshold include tax?

No. It uses the cart subtotal before tax, which is how WooCommerce’s own free shipping rule usually works.

Is it compatible with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)?

Yes.
